finding.summary: An incomplete review still advances the incremental baseline. When run_file_review returns result.incomplete for a file, the loop continues, render_report is called with head_sha (recording it as the 'Reviewed commit' in the posted comment), and only afterwards does main() return 1. On the next --since-last-review run, find_last_review_comment locates that comment, reviewed_sha extracts head_sha, and the 'last_sha == head_sha' check exits 0 with 'Nothing to review' — so files flagged incomplete are permanently skipped by incremental reviews, contradicting the PR's fail-loudly goal of never risking a false all-clear.
finding.fix: When incomplete_files is non-empty, do not record head_sha as the reviewed commit: pass head_sha=None (or the pre-review baseline SHA) to render_report so the posted comment omits or backdates the baseline, causing the next --since-last-review run to fall back to a full review and re-cover the incomplete files. Alternatively, abort before posting (and before recording the baseline) when any file review was incomplete.
